source_provenance.question: Estimate the point(s) at which the graph of odd function f  has a local maximum or a local minimum.
source_provenance.previous_model_response:
The graph changes from increasing to decreasing near \(x=-3\), so it has a local maximum there. By odd symmetry, there is a corresponding local minimum near \(x=3\). From the scale, the extrema are approximately \(y=\pm 54\).

\[
\text{Local maximum: }(-3,54), \qquad \text{Local minimum: }(3,-54)
\]

Final value: \(\boxed{(-3,54)\text{ and }(3,-54)}\)
